documents.title: Independence County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 150 pages. Amounts are the Ordinance Section 7 'Amount Appropriated' (County General offices, p. 2) and each fund's category amounts and totals (pp. 3-17). County General office categories come from the worksheets' '2026 Request'/'2026 Budget' column (Category A + Category B), pp. 18-67. column.
